post.description:
Initiate an M-Pesa STK Push.

This endpoint only starts the M-Pesa payment request.

It does not create a ledger entry.
Ledger processing happens after the M-Pesa callback
is received and successfully reconciled.

get.summary: Get the authenticated landlord context
get.description:
Return the authenticated landlord context.

The landlord scope comes from the verified membership. The service
and repository query that scope through the normal RLS-bound session.

401.description: Authentication is required or the token is invalid.

403.description: An active landlord membership is required.

get.summary: Get Caretaker Context
get.description:
Return the authenticated caretaker context.

This endpoint establishes the caretaker API boundary
and verifies that the authenticated principal is both
a caretaker and has unit-read permission.

schema.title: Response Get Caretaker Context Api V1 Bff Caretaker Me Get

ItemKV.title: ItemKV
ItemKV.description: Single Name/Value item from M-Pesa CallbackMetadata.

Role.title: Role
Role.description:
Application roles.

LANDLORD:
    Full administrative control over the landlord's portfolio.

CARETAKER:
    Restricted operational access.

TENANT:
    Limited tenant-facing access.

ADMIN:
    Platform administration and operations.

SYSTEM:
    Trusted internal service-to-service operations.
